steps.note: HttpRequestHandlerTest: OpenMetrics when the Accept header asks for it

mask.reason: JvmMetricsCollector's Netty direct-memory gauge, as jvm_*: no counterpart outside the JVM
exported only where /proc/sys/net/core/somaxconn is readable (the oracle's Linux container, not a macOS host)
upstream's JVM heap-size estimates of log entries and expectations
the oracle's gauge stays one above its open sockets after its JVM start-up warm-up request (1 with MOCKSERVER_STARTUP_WARMUP=false, no extra socket in its /proc/net/tcp); ours counts open sockets
